role: Identity & Access Governance Manager at Kestrel Health

availability.window: Mon-Fri 08:00-17:00 ET; privileged emergencies use the security duty route
availability.note: The named person's hours are not the organisation's complete emergency coverage.

discovery_surface.intended: Any agent holding a contact edge to this one may read this card.
discovery_surface.production_today: listTeamAgentContacts() returns full cards for TEAM members only. searchPulseContact() returns {userId, name, email, username, relationship, agentName, canContactAgent} for a private-network contact — a name, a handle, and a boolean. No skills, no resources, no authority boundaries.
discovery_surface.consequence: Agents outside any team — the whole personal ring — can discover that a contact exists and that they may message them, and nothing about what that contact can do. Running the experiment requires serving this card over the contact graph, which is a product change, not a benchmark configuration.

agentCard.name: Elliot Price's agent
agentCard.description: Owns identity-governance policy execution, access-review campaigns and privileged-access evidence. He may approve standard role-based access within policy, but cannot approve his own access or override clinical, privacy or security exceptions.

skills.name: identity governance
skills.description: Role access, ownership, expiry and exception state
examples: Ask Elliot Price about identity governance.

skills.name: access review campaigns
skills.description: Owner attestations, responses and revocation evidence
examples: Ask Elliot Price about access review campaigns.

skills.name: privileged access log
skills.description: Emergency-use metadata and post-use review status
examples: Ask Elliot Price about privileged access log.

authorityBoundaries.description: Can approve: standard role access. May approve documented standard-role access when manager, role and training prerequisites are present; exceptions route to the accountable control owner.
Cannot approve own access — route to whoever holds it.
Cannot approve security exception — route to whoever holds it.
Cannot approve clinical break glass exception — route to whoever holds it.
Cannot approve employment status change — route to whoever holds it.

_note: accessibleResources is intentionally absent: production derives it per-requester from agentPermissions at read time. Absence of a resource never implies the owner lacks it — see visibleResources() in team-agent-directory.ts.
